# Vlad Feninets

Senior Product Engineer · TypeScript, Node.js, AI agents in production

Vienna, Austria (CET)

## Summary

Senior product engineer with 11 years in JavaScript and TypeScript, frontend-heavy full stack, building products and the AI agents that run them in production. Since 2022, building the real-time trading frontend of [XBO.com](https://xbo.com), an award-winning crypto exchange: heavy WebSocket traffic, exact decimal money math, 17 languages. Since mid-2026, delivering there through an agent workflow built around the team's Azure DevOps flow, with coding agents on each task and multi-model review of every PR. Before XBO, frontend tech lead at robota.ua, the largest job board in Ukraine.

Co-founded and built two AI products: [ELI](https://elispeak.com), an English tutor with [52 active paid subscriptions](https://trustmrr.com/startup/elispeak) (Whisper, phoneme-level pronunciation scoring, LLM dialogue, serverless AWS, Stripe), and [Mrrlin](https://mrrlin.com), a workspace that turns a goal into tasks for Claude Code or Codex (beta, public MCP package with [about 30k npm downloads a month](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mrrlin-dev/mcp)). Built alone the agent harness that runs the day-to-day operations of both products in production from a Telegram chat.

## Experience

### Senior Frontend Engineer · [XBO.com](https://xbo.com), crypto exchange (04/2022 - now)

Web trading frontend and client area of an award-winning crypto exchange (Best Digital Assets Exchange 2024, Best Crypto Processing Solution 2025): spot, futures and CFDs.

- Designed the real-time data layer on SignalR/WebSockets: order books, charts, tickers and positions update in under a second.
- Kept the UI responsive under high-frequency streams with RxJS-based state management.
- Moved trading calculations to arbitrary-precision arithmetic and built type-safe order forms with real-time validation.
- Ships client-area flows with the backend, QA and compliance teams (withdrawals, fiat bank-account whitelisting, DAC8 reporting data) in 17 languages.
- Since mid-2026, delivers through an agent workflow of his own around the team's Azure DevOps flow: agents turn user stories into implementation-ready specs, coding agents implement each task, a multi-model consensus gate reviews the design and each of his PRs, and browser and Figma QA agents verify the result.

Stack: React, Redux, TypeScript, SignalR, RxJS; Claude Code, Codex, MCP

### Lead Frontend & DevOps Engineer · ducky.app (12/2021 - 04/2022)

B2B benefits platform startup: chose Angular + Tailwind, set up the frontend architecture, CI/CD and environments.

### Frontend Engineer → Frontend Tech Lead · [robota.ua](https://robota.ua) (11/2016 - 12/2021)

The largest job board in Ukraine (6.5M+ resumes). Grew from mid-level engineer to tech lead of the frontend platform.

- Moved the 20-year-old product's .NET/jQuery monolith to Angular + GraphQL services; built the mobile SPA from scratch.
- Cut CI builds from about 40 to about 20 minutes (TeamCity to GitHub Actions, incremental builds, caching).
- Moved key pages from red to green Core Web Vitals; introduced TypeScript strict mode, SonarQube and Sentry.

## Independent Projects

### [ELI](https://elispeak.com), AI English tutor · built the whole technical side (11/2024 - now)

Co-founded and live with paying users: [52 active paid subscriptions](https://trustmrr.com/startup/elispeak) and ~780 registered users as of 11/2026. Pronunciation and goal-based speaking practice for job interviews, work meetings and relocation.

- Built the voice pipeline: Whisper speech recognition on serverless GPU and phoneme-level pronunciation scoring.
- Fine-tuned GPT models for the tutor's dialogue (LangChain), driven by a learner profile updated after every conversation.
- Built the serverless, event-driven AWS backend (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, DynamoDB, CloudFront, Cognito) plus GCP/Firebase, and Stripe subscriptions tiered by speaking minutes.

### [Mrrlin](https://mrrlin.com), workspace for coding agents · designed and built (06/2026 - now)

Co-founded, in beta. Grew out of running ELI, where coding agents needed control, verification and memory; most coding work on both products now runs through it. A Director turns one goal into a task plan and routes tasks to Claude Code, Codex CLI and other models.

- Mrrlin: a TypeScript monorepo with a Next.js 15 operator dashboard, a Hono REST API with shared Zod schemas and generated OpenAPI, Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security, and Stripe subscriptions; tested with pgTAP, Playwright end-to-end tests and a fast CI gate.
- Task state lives in a strictly typed PostgreSQL state machine with atomic transition checks and sticky agent assignment, replacing flat Markdown task files.
- Its public npm package @mrrlin-dev/mcp ([~30k downloads a month](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mrrlin-dev/mcp)), an MCP server plus a background bridge that runs on Linux, macOS and Windows, lets a local Claude Code or Codex agent take Mrrlin tasks; weak output goes back through multi-model consensus review, and a task closes only with proof (a live URL, a green build or a human sign-off).

### Agent operations harness · built alone (2026 - now)

An always-on agent system that runs the day-to-day operations of ELI and Mrrlin in production, steered from Telegram by text or voice messages, one channel per workflow.

- Handles helpdesk for both products (support and refunds), answers leads (outreach and reply triage), writes SEO content, posts to X and other networks, produces TikTok videos in Google Flow, reacts to alerts and ships quick product changes.
- Built on Hermes Agent with a TypeScript service that gives parallel agents leases on jobs, plus idempotency keys so a retried action does not run twice.
- Review gates: reviewer models from other providers score outgoing messages against hard rules before they are sent.

Stack: Hermes Agent, TypeScript, Node.js, Hono, SQLite, Telegram
